patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service where the client makes requests to a server that processes them and returns the response.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The system is divided into three layers: presentation layer, business layer, and data layer.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: The business and data layers are divided into several different services to improve security, scalability, and availability.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: A design pattern that allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform, handling authorization and SSL.

patterns.name: Data Lake
patterns.description: A centralized repository that allows for the storage of structured and unstructured data at any scale without needing to modify or structure it initially.
